map.washer-capacity：在线输入参数即可即时得到结果，无需安装与注册。: washer-capacity: enter parameters online to get results instantly, no installation or registration needed.
map.填写「常洗大件（床单被套/窗帘）」。: Fill in 'Frequently washed large items (sheets/duvet covers/curtains)'.
map.三口之家选 7–8kg，常洗床单被套需 ≥8kg，确保冬被一次洗净不缠团。: A household of three should pick 7–8 kg; washing sheets and duvet covers needs ≥8 kg so winter duvets wash clean in one load without tangling.
map.五口 / 大户型选 10kg，窗帘等大件 ≥9kg 一次过水，减少分批。: A five-person household or large home should pick 10 kg; large items like curtains need ≥9 kg to wash in one go, reducing split loads.
map.用水量敏感家庭：滚筒约 9L/kg、波轮约 30L/kg，同等容量波轮费水约 3: For water-conscious households: a front loader uses about 9 L/kg and a top loader about 30 L/kg, so at equal capacity a top loader uses roughly 3× the water.
map.：4 口 → 基准 8–9kg；常洗冬被 / 窗帘 → 取 9kg。滚筒 9L/: : 4 people → baseline 8–9 kg; frequent winter duvets / curtains → pick 9 kg. Front loader 9 L/kg×9=81 L/load, top loader 30×9=270 L/load; at 20 loads per month, the front loader saves (270−81)×20=3780 L of water per month versus the top loader.
map.容量按人口还是按件定？: Size capacity by people or by load items?
map.先按人口定基准：1–2 人 5–6kg、3 人 7–8kg、4 人 8–9kg、: Start from a per-person baseline: 1–2 people 5–6 kg, 3 people 7–8 kg, 4 people 8–9 kg, 5+ people 10 kg; then raise it for large items (sheets and duvet covers ≥8 kg, curtains ≥9 kg).
map.滚筒省水护衣、贵；波轮便宜费水、伤衣少。小户型看水压与安装位，大件多选大容量滚筒: Front loaders save water and are gentlier on clothes but cost more; top loaders are cheaper but use more water and are harder on fabrics. For small homes consider water pressure and installation space; with many large items choose a large-capacity front loader; for rentals or occasional use a top loader is more economical.
